data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,714k in the year, predominately in respect of Accident and Health business (2016: GBP 3,031k, predominately in respect of Property and Accident and Health businesses).

named_events.loss_description: storms in the South-eastern USA and Caribbean in September 2017, compounded by two earthquakes occurring in Mexico, collectively referred to as the "HIMM" losses where the syndicate had exposure in the property, marine and contingency classes.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 77.173m. During 2017 the Technical Provisions note shows a gross strengthening in prior year provisions of GBP 12.581m (c.16.3% of opening gross claims outstanding), i.e. an adverse movement requiring additional reserves. The report also contains a narrative sentence describing a small positive run-off deviation (net) of GBP 3.714m predominately in Accident & Health, indicating there are differences between net run-off metrics and the gross movement disclosed in the Technical Provisions note.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and gross prior-year movement taken from Technical Provisions (note 16) table (GBP 000). exact_reserve_text is a narrative line describing a net run-off deviation (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross movement in the Technical Provisions table. Claims development triangle has been transcribed from the 'Claims development' table but some cell values were read from a scan and approximated to the nearest reported thousands; triangle units are thousands.
